name: DFARS Cybersecurity Clauses
description: Contractual cyber obligations for covered defense information, cyber incident reporting, NIST SP 800-171 assessments, and CMMC applicability.

requirements.title: Safeguard covered defense information
requirements.description: Identify covered defense information and protect it on covered contractor information systems using the contractually applicable security requirements.

requirements.title: Report cyber incidents
requirements.description: Maintain the capability to identify, report, preserve, and support investigation of reportable cyber incidents within the required contract timeline.

requirements.title: Preserve incident evidence
requirements.description: Preserve images, relevant monitoring data, and other information needed for DoD forensic analysis after a reportable incident.

requirements.title: Maintain NIST assessment status
requirements.description: Maintain the current NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment result and the contractual assessment evidence required for the covered system.

requirements.title: Support DoD assessment access
requirements.description: Maintain the system, records, and personnel access needed to support a DoD assessment when the clause applies.

requirements.title: Flow down applicable requirements
requirements.description: Identify subcontractors and suppliers that receive covered information and document applicable clause flowdown and evidence responsibilities.

requirements.title: Determine CMMC applicability
requirements.description: Determine whether the contract requires CMMC and retain the applicable level, scope, affirmation, and assessment evidence.
